messages:
Rae: FYI - Iris dedicated saw a short peering disruption during a KV checkpoint at 11:02 UTC. Symptoms: TCP retransmits + transient BGP flap. Not full outage but customer worried.
Tom: Which peering link? onprem-sfo <-> iris-prod?
Rae: Yep, onprem-sfo. Packet sample saved to ticket.
Leah: Recurring pattern? We saw similar for Kestrel last month. Could be checkpoint collision.
Rae: Suggest immediate actions: assign owner, enable short-term pcap ring, add alert correlation for checkpoint+retransmits.
Tom: I can own remediation and customer comms.
Leah: I'll add pcap hook and update observability rule to only alert when checkpoint_active=true AND retransmit_pct>1%. ETA: 6h.
Customer-Net: We'll provide firewall logs and can run a quick MTU check.
ops-bot: Created PM issue labelling `peering-patterns` and attached template `pm-onprem-peering-v1`.
Rae: Action items recorded: Tom - owner & customer updates (48h), Leah - pcap+alert (EOD), Rae - add to recurring-incidents board.
Tom: I'll draft a short RCA and propose a mitigation: stagger checkpoint windows by tenant group.
Leah: Also logging tweak: add kv.checkpoint.size & start_ts to peering dashboard for 60 days.
Rae: Thanks. WG invite for triage going out.
Tom: Posting customer note now: "We've assigned an owner and are investigating peering instability during checkpointing. Expect update in 48h."
Leah: Adding follow-up test: simulate 5 simultaneous checkpoints in staging peered topology next week.
Rae: Closing thread for now; will reopen if more events show up. :thumbsup:
